notes: Tiny tier after rounds a-c: +370 newly solved, 23 lost. Real: HS119 asls-pcg-exact/pasls, DEGENQP pasls. First pass exposed 8 cap regressions (HS13 x5, BIGGS3, HS119, LSNNODOC).

title: Run the KKT test before step acceptance, ahead of the fatal flags
notes: Small gain: HS111, TAME on trip, DUAL1/DUAL3 on pasls. Label termination_missed (kkt_last<1e-3) mostly means slow convergence, not a missed test.

title: Rounding-level rejections do not count as secant failures
notes: PRICE4B (4 line-search configs), BQPGASIM. 0/34 secant_recovery_premature. Needed two guards after MATRIX2 became a false success: QP-optimality shortcut keeps its recovery gate; stationarity scale ignores multipliers of an unconverged QP.

title: mu update on scaled barrier KKT error (kappa_eps*mu) + xtol-style radius-collapse exit, collapse_resets_secant=True
notes: Before: 3/66. Tiny trip/tfip vs regress_tiny2: +46/-6 (HS119 tfip, HS30 tfip/trip, HS55 tfip, LSNNODOC trip, PRICE4B trip). One failing test at the last full run: test_infeasible_run_reports_multiplier_bound_hits. Open: HS100 predicted-reduction at rounding level.

title: Same as d-barrier-v2 with collapse_resets_secant=False (user's secant-reset hypothesis)
notes: Identical to v2 on the 66 tasks and on the tiny trip/tfip regression, so the flag showed no effect; either it never triggers here or the v1 build did not differ as intended. Hypothesis untested.

title: Round d: attribution of the six tiny-tier losses at HEAD
notes: All six losses reproduce deterministically at HEAD (not noise; fstar ok except LSNNODOC unverified/nan). HS30 trip/tfip: f within 5e-6..1.4e-5 of f*, kkt 2.7e-6..9.7e-6 > atol 1e-6 after mu reaches 1e-7 (10 updates), 500 steps (termination_missed). PRICE4B trip: f=3.6e-13, radius 1.5e-8, status trust_region_collapse. HS119 tfip: f matches f*, multiplier_solve_failure at mu 1e-7. LSNNODOC trip: f=123.112449 both before and after, fstar nan (unverified), now ends trust_region_collapse with kkt 18. HS55 tfip: now successful at f=6.6667 vs f*=6.3333 in 16 steps (before: 6.33333 in 32 steps): false success, protocol stop-and-ask. collapse_resets_secant True vs False: identical on 5 of 6, LSNNODOC trip 116 vs 123 steps only; the flag triggers but does not change outcomes. test_infeasible_run_reports_multiplier_bound_hits passes at HEAD. Common pattern: the new schedule drives mu to ~1e-7 where the end game (kkt noise above atol, multiplier solve, radius collapse) fails; old code stopped earlier.
